title: 丝芙兰进驻：ChatGPT，购物新入口？
speaker: Lisa Mateo

segments.en: When someone actually engages our sent advisor, they're sort of twice the kind of carcise where the purchase. Beauty companies are also using partnerships to meet the consumer where they are.
segments.zh: 当消费者真正与香氛顾问互动时，他们的购买转化率大约是两倍。美妆公司还通过合作来贴近消费者。

segments.en: Sephora is teaming up with open AI to launch its app in chat. The consumer can browse the full Sephora catalog. They can get product recommendations, advice, even link their beauty insider loyalty account.
segments.zh: 丝芙兰与OpenAI合作，在ChatGPT中推出其应用。消费者可以浏览完整目录，获取产品推荐、建议，甚至关联Beauty Insider忠诚账户。

segments.en: Estee Lauder is working with Shopify. You can do your search, you can do your analysis, talk to Gemini Pro or you know using chat. And then you can go through and you could purchase and then it will check you out through Shopify.
segments.zh: 雅诗兰黛与Shopify合作。你可以进行搜索、分析，与Gemini Pro对话或使用聊天，然后完成购买，并通过Shopify结账。

segments.en: And it's not just online. The AI is reshaping routine tasks in the office. Elf Beauty uses a number of tools to increase productivity.
segments.zh: 这不仅仅局限于线上。AI正在重塑办公室的日常任务。Elf Beauty使用多种工具提高生产力。

segments.en: When chat GPT sort of was showcased in the world, we built our own product called BFL. That's our internal chat GPT that our teams use to write, create newsletters or product descriptions and things like that.
segments.zh: 当ChatGPT问世时，我们构建了自己的产品BFL，这是内部ChatGPT，团队用它来撰写新闻稿、产品描述等。

segments.en: The teams are excited, they're like, oh my god, I'm getting to do new stuff and the mundane work is being done by AI. AI is the power and the humans give it purpose.
segments.zh: 团队很兴奋，他们觉得‘天哪，我能做新事情了，枯燥的工作由AI完成’。AI是力量，人类赋予它意义。
